name: Self Image
overview: Scripture reveals that human self-image is rooted in being created in the very image of God, as affirmed in Genesis 1:27, highlighting the inherent dignity and worth of every person. The Psalmist acknowledges this divine craftsmanship, praising God for making us fearfully and wonderfully (Psalm 139:14). Our bodies and lives are to be offered as living sacrifices to God, reflecting holiness and acceptance before Him (Romans 12:1). Trusting God rather than fearing man secures our true safety and identity (Proverbs 29:25), while recognizing that God has made all things beautiful in His time, including the unique work He has done in each of us (Ecclesiastes 3:11).
